bio_en: Aram Hakobian, called Pztik ('Little') Aram, was born in 1883 into a modest family of the Dzor quarter of Mush and went to work young to support his family. Gentle but fiery, he joined the 'Vardanants' group of the ARF in Mush and until 1903 served as a courier on responsible missions; once, carrying lead for the committee, he was warned to hide and was sheltered in the homes of Hayrapet Dimaksian and of the band leader Mjo. He went on to fight on many fronts until the foundation of the Republic of Armenia.
